body.heading: Where in the world is Zimbabwe?
paragraphs: Zimbabwe is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Zimbabwe is Harare.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Zimbabwe speak English, Shona and North Ndebele.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Zimbabwe is the US dollar. Yes — the very same dollars used in the United States! Shops in Zimbabwe accept US dollars day to day, alongside the country's own currency.

body.heading: How big is Zimbabwe?
paragraphs: Zimbabwe covers about 391,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Mozambique.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: From the Zimbabwe side, a rainforest path leads past view after view of Victoria Falls' main curtain — bring a raincoat for the spray!
Great Zimbabwe is a medieval stone city of towering walls built without any mortar — the largest ancient structure in sub-Saharan Africa and the country's namesake.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Zimbabwe on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
